title: Brandon Miller (groin) upgraded to active Sunday vs. Clippers
text:
Hornets forward Brandon Miller (groin) upgraded to active vs. Clippers NBA Rumors NBA Stats Odds Betting Shop ROOKIE Brandon Miller (groin) upgraded to active Sunday vs. Clippers
 After a brief two-game absence, Brandon Miller has been upgraded for Charlotte's Sunday matchup against the Los Angeles Clippers.
 Mack Baltes Rookie Wire Nov. 15, 2026, 6:31 a.m. ET Charlotte Hornets forward Brandon Miller was upgraded to active for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Clippers.
 Miller, the team's leading scorer, missed the previous two games with a groin injury.
 The Hornets' injury report is shortening, with Grant Williams also recently returning to the lineup.
 Only Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder remain sidelined for Charlotte due to hamstring strains.
 The Charlotte Hornets received more positive news Saturday night, as star forward Brandon Miller was upgraded to active for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Clippers . Miller, Charlotte's leading scorer, had been sidelined for the last two games after suffering a groin injury against the Boston Celtics.
 This season, Miller is averaging 20.6 points, five rebounds, 2.2 assists, 1.1 steals and 0.7 blocks. However, the former No. 2 overall pick has struggled with offensive efficiency, shooting a career-low 35.6% from the field and 26% from beyond the arc. Following the return of Grant Williams, who made his season debut Thursday, Charlotte's injury report is beginning to clear up.
 Only two players remain injured, Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder, both of whom are sidelined with left hamstring strains. Knueppel has played only six minutes this season due to injury, while Schroder is averaging 10.2 points, 4.9 assists, 3.6 rebounds and 0.8 steals in nine games to begin the year.
